+    """Panda hand TCP FK, with the base mounted at (0, -.4, .6)."""
+    t = np.eye(4)

+    return tip[:3], t[:3, :3]
+
+
+def ik(position, seed, vertical_weight=.16):
+    """Reach a TCP position while keeping the gripper pointed downward."""
+    seed = np.array(seed[:7], dtype=float)
+    lower, upper = PANDA_LIMITS.T
+    seed = np.clip(seed, lower + 1e-4, upper - 1e-4)
